:::info Contract pending
There is no approved API contract in this initial documentation. Routes,
versioning, request/response models, and authentication are still to be agreed.
:::

The reference will describe the supported operations, authentication requirements,
request and response schemas, validation rules, and error responses.

Once the backend team has approved a contract, its reviewed reference can be
linked or generated here. This scaffold intentionally contains no invented API
endpoints and no duplicate OpenAPI specification.
